title: Bazel can't detect build_file after addition

labels.name: P2

body:
### Summary

1. Try to build a rule in a `new_http_archive` when the `build_file` is not present - it fails as expected.
1. Create the `build_file`.
1. Try again, it still fails.

### Workaround

Change `build_file` to an invalid setting (eg "404.BUILD"), try to build, restore the correct value, try again.

### Reproduction

```
➜  cat WORKSPACE 
new_http_archive(
    name = "com_github_octocat_hello_world",
    build_file = "hello.BUILD",
    sha256 = "39a4b97b9d108782fa7466b07160a2c9227a7da07725ad4110c41be6014e4160",
    strip_prefix = "Hello-World-7fd1a60b01f91b314f59955a4e4d4e80d8edf11d",
    url = "https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World/archive/7fd1a60b01f91b314f59955a4e4d4e80d8edf11d.tar.gz",
)
➜  cat hello.BUILD
cat: hello.BUILD: No such file or directory
➜  bazel build @com_github_octocat_hello_world//:README
...............
ERROR: Skipping '@com_github_octocat_hello_world//:README': no such package '@com_github_octocat_hello_world//': In new_http_archive rule //external:com_github_octocat_hello_world the 'build_file' attribute does not specify an existing file (/usr/local/google/home/rodrigoq/git/bazeltest/cant_find_build/hello.BUILD does not exist)
WARNING: Target pattern parsing failed.
ERROR: no such package '@com_github_octocat_hello_world//': In new_http_archive rule //external:com_github_octocat_hello_world the 'build_file' attribute does not specify an existing file (/usr/local/google/home/rodrigoq/git/bazeltest/cant_find_build/hello.BUILD does not exist)
INFO: Elapsed time: 0.702s
FAILED: Build did NOT complete successfully (0 packages loaded)
➜  echo 'exports_files(["README"])' > hello.BUILD
➜  bazel build @com_github_octocat_hello_world//:README
ERROR: Skipping '@com_github_octocat_hello_world//:README': no such package '@com_github_octocat_hello_world//': In new_http_archive rule //external:com_github_octocat_hello_world the 'build_file' attribute does not specify an existing file (/usr/local/google/home/rodrigoq/git/bazeltest/cant_find_build/hello.BUILD does not exist)
WARNING: Target pattern parsing failed.
ERROR: no such package '@com_github_octocat_hello_world//': In new_http_archive rule //external:com_github_octocat_hello_world the 'build_file' attribute does not specify an existing file (/usr/local/google/home/rodrigoq/git/bazeltest/cant_find_build/hello.BUILD does not exist)
INFO: Elapsed time: 0.103s
FAILED: Build did NOT complete successfully (0 packages loaded)
➜  cat /usr/local/google/home/rodrigoq/git/bazeltest/cant_find_build/hello.BUILD
exports_files(["README"])
```

### Environment info
* Operating System: Ubuntu 14.04
* Bazel version: 0.5.3
